overview_description.description: SimpleHash is a REST and webhook-based API that provides the ability to query NFT metadata, media, and transaction history, including sales, listings, and floor prices, across multiple chains. They build APIs and developer tooling to abstract away this complexity for developers. They provide preview versions of the relevant media file within the previews field.

product.name: SimpleHash Multi-Chain Token & NFT API
product.description: A REST API providing access to token and NFT data, including market prices, metadata, ownership, and transaction history across 80+ blockchain networks.

product.name: SimpleHash Kafka Streaming Service
product.description: A high-throughput Kafka-based streaming service delivering real-time token and NFT data streams for large-scale ingestion and processing.

product.name: NFT Metadata and Media Management
product.description: A system that maintains up-to-date NFT metadata and cached media previews, including dynamic refreshing and spam filtering.
